September 26, 1952

MEMORANDUM

RE: STEFANO MAGADDINO, with aliases
    Stefano Magaddino, Steve
    Magadino, Steve Magadine,
    Steve Margadino [uncertain]

It is reported that Magaddino was born in Castellammare,
Italy on October 10, 1898, and to have entered the United States
at New York City on February 7, 1909. He is said to have
resided at 1653 Whitney Avenue, Niagara Falls, New York in
October, 1951, and to have become a naturalized citizen on
November 24, 1924, Certificate of Citizenship number 2900482.

He is reported to dominate gambling and underworld
activities in the Niagara Falls, New York area. He is reportedly
the President of the Power City Distributing Company, LaSalle
Avenue, Niagara Falls, New York.

There is no known arrest record for Magaddino.
